name: Sprayfeather Gill
description: A special feather-shaped species that grows by the seaside. It looks kind of like a seagrass but is in truth a soft-bodied aquatic coral with a unique shape.
fullDescription:
A special feather-shaped species that grows by the seaside. It looks kind of like a seagrass but is in truth a soft-bodied aquatic coral with a unique shape.
It is said that the Koholasaurs of the People of the Springs love to snack upon them.
sources: Recommendation: Found near the "People of the Springs"
